label: myadhd.my
caption:
Walked into the room. Stood there. No idea why.

That is working memory, not carelessness. Swipe for why the thought vanishes so fast, and three ways to catch it before it goes.

If this sounded like your brain, come sit with people who get it. Our group is in my bio 👇

Save this, then write down what you forgot.

#adhd #adhdmalaysia #myadhd #adhdadult #workingmemory

slides.title:
Why do I
[[forget]] what I
was doing?
slides.sub: It is not that you do not care. Your brain's notepad is just small.

slides.title:
Your mental
notepad is
[[small]]
slides.body: Working memory holds what you are doing right now. In many ADHD brains it holds less, and it wipes easily. One new thought, and the old one is gone.

slides.title:
A doorway
[[wipes it]] clean
slides.body: New room, new scene, and the reason you came is gone. Standing in the kitchen with no idea why is not old age. It is a full notepad.

slides.title:
"I'll remember"
is a [[trap]]
slides.body: It feels so clear in the moment that writing it down seems silly. Ten minutes later it is gone, and so is the memory that there was anything.

slides.title:
Forgetting is
not [[not caring]]
slides.body: Missing a birthday or a promise can look like you do not care. You care a lot. The memory just was not kept anywhere it could come back from.

slides.title:
Write it down
[[right now]]
slides.body: Not later, not after this. One app, one notebook, one place. If a thought is worth keeping, it is worth ten seconds before it disappears.

slides.title:
Say it [[out loud]]
as you go
slides.body: "Going to get the scissors." Saying the task out loud keeps it in the room with you. It feels odd, and it works.

slides.title:
Leave [[clues]]
where you
already look
slides.body: Keys on the bag. The letter on your shoes. A note on the door. Put the reminder where your eyes already go, not where it belongs.

slides.title:
Save this, then
[[write down]]
what you forgot
slides.body: Your memory is not letting you down on purpose. It just needs a second place to keep things. Dump everything into my.adhd and get one thing back.
